annotations.title: Benchmark your MRR against category peers

description: Where does your MRR sit among fresh, same-category MRR peers on MRR Ledger? Returns peers {n, basis "MRR", 90-day window, excluded counts, verification e.g. "payment-verified via TrustMRR, as of 2026-10-20"}, position {rank of N (you + N listed peers); percentile only where at least 10 fresh peers exist, in the full answer}, comparables (free: 1 with name and link; full: 5 nearest with dated MRR, confidence label and source), method, caveat, growth status (no growth numbers yet: tracking started Oct 15, first 30-day figures ~mid-Nov). MRR only, never mixed with ARR; months_live is accepted but ignored; your MRR is never stored, published, ranked or badged. Example: {"category":"customer-support","mrr":2000} -> your rank among the fresh customer-support MRR peers + 1 comparable. Cost: free, 100 tools/call per day without a key (API keys from $9/mo raise the limit). Full answer (percentile where 10+ peers, 5 sourced comparables): $0.05 via x402 (params._meta["x402/payment"], or full: true for the terms), included with Builder, Team and Pro keys and with a $9 Category Report token for that category (report_token).

category.description: Category slug, e.g. customer-support, automation-platforms, sales-gtm, indie-solo (see list_categories).

full.description: true = ask for the full answer (needs a Builder/Team/Pro key or a Category Report token for this category; otherwise you get the free answer plus how to unlock).

months_live.description: Optional months since launch (0-600). Accepted but ignored for now.

mrr.description: Your monthly recurring revenue in USD, e.g. 2000 (greater than 0, at most 100000000). Not stored.

report_token.description: Optional: the 48-hex token from a Category Report for this category (unlocks full answers for its 7-day window).
